_about: The gameplay options' "Disable private messages at the time of battle" checkbox, which did nothing (the option had no console variable), is the match chat option since exe patch 58: checked, the other players' chat lines are not shown in a match. Its label says so, in the six localization tables (docs/notes/match-hud-options.md).
